summary.description: _duration_ms histogram for the foreground_session span - elapsed time between the app entering and leaving the foreground, equivalent to New Relic's sessionDuration. Uses a manually-instrumented span rather than the Capture SDK's automatic AppStart/AppStop logs (used by bd-shop-13/15) because a two-step measure-time-between-logs correlation proved unreliable at real cycling volume; a span's self-contained duration field avoids that.
